summary: The recursive path types (Path, FieldPath and the name types built on them) stop at 10 segments: a field name nested 11 or more levels deep is no longer a valid path for register, setValue, watch etc., where before every depth was generated

When a change event from an <input type="file"> is passed to a controlled field's onChange (Controller / useController field.onChange), the stored value is the input's FileList instead of its string value (the fake C:\fakepath\… path)

The <FormStateSubscribe> render-prop component is renamed <FormState> (props type FormStateSubscribeProps → FormStateProps); FormStateSubscribe and FormStateSubscribeProps remain only as @deprecated aliases
handleSubmit(onValid)(event) now resolves to the value returned by onValid (Promise<Awaited<TResult> | undefined>, generic over TResult) instead of always resolving to undefined (typed Promise<void>)
